rules.name: usdGeomValidators:StageMetadataChecker
rules.summary: All stages must declare their 'upAxis' and 'metersPerUnit'.

rules.name: usdGeomValidators:SubsetFamilies
rules.summary: Validates all of the geom subset families authored beneath an Imageable prim.

rules.name: usdGeomValidators:SubsetParentIsImageable
rules.summary: Validates that GeomSubset prims are direct descendants of an Imageable prim.

rules.name: usdLuxValidators:EncapsulationRulesValidator
rules.summary: Connectable prims in UsdLux (e.g. Light, LightFilters) can only be nested inside other Container-like Connectable prims (UsdShadeNodeGraph, UsdLuxLight or UsdLuxLightFilter).

rules.name: usdMediaValidators:AuthorshipInputsPaired
rules.summary: inputs on an authorship record must hold (name, value) pairs: its length must be a multiple of the tuple-length given by its arraySizeConstraint.

rules.name: usdMediaValidators:ShadowedOrDuplicateAuthorship

rules.name: usdPhysicsValidators:ArticulationChecker
rules.summary: Validates all of the UsdPhysicsArticulationRootAPIs applied to a prim.

rules.name: usdPhysicsValidators:ColliderChecker
rules.summary: Validates all of the UsdPhysicsCollisionAPIs applied to a prim.

rules.name: usdPhysicsValidators:PhysicsJointChecker
rules.summary: Validates all of the UsdPhysicsJoint prims.

rules.name: usdPhysicsValidators:RigidBodyChecker
rules.summary: Validates all of the UsdPhysicsRigidBodyAPIs applied to a prim.

rules.name: usdShadeValidators:EncapsulationRulesValidator
rules.summary: Connectable prims (e.g. Shader, Material, etc) can only be nested inside other Container-like Connectable prims. Container-like prims include Material, NodeGraph. Shader is not a Container-like prim.

rules.name: usdShadeValidators:MaterialBindingApiAppliedValidator
rules.summary: Verify a prim has the MaterialBindingAPI applied if it has a material binding relationship.

rules.name: usdShadeValidators:MaterialBindingCollectionValidator
rules.summary: Verify that a collection defining a material binding is well-formed

rules.name: usdShadeValidators:MaterialBindingRelationships
rules.summary: All properties named 'material:binding' or in that namespace should be relationships.

rules.name: usdShadeValidators:NormalMapTextureValidator

rules.name: usdShadeValidators:ShaderSdrCompliance
rules.summary: Shader prim's input types must be conforming to their appropriate sdf types in the respective sdr shader.

rules.name: usdShadeValidators:SubsetMaterialBindFamilyName
rules.summary: Geom subsets with authored material bindings should have the 'materialBind' family name.

rules.name: usdShadeValidators:SubsetsMaterialBindFamily
rules.summary: Geom subsets of the 'materialBind' family should have a restricted family type.

rules.name: usdSkelValidators:SkelBindingApiAppliedValidator
rules.summary: Verify a prim has the SkelBindingAPI applied if it has a UsdSkelBinding property.

rules.name: usdSkelValidators:SkelBindingApiValidator
rules.summary: Verify that a prim with SkelBindingAPI applied, is either of SkelRoot type or parented by a SkelRoot prim.

rules.name: usdUtilsValidators:FileExtensionValidator
rules.summary: Only valid core layer extensions (.usd, .usda, .usdc, .usdz), valid core texture extensions (.exr, .jpg, .jpeg, .png) and embedded audio files (.M4A, .MP3, .WAV) are allowed in a package.

rules.name: usdUtilsValidators:MissingReferenceValidator
rules.summary: The composed USD stage should not contain any unresolvable asset dependencies (in every possible variation of the asset), when using the default asset resolver.

rules.name: usdUtilsValidators:PackageEncapsulationValidator
rules.summary: If the root layer is a package, then its recommended for the composed stage to not contain references to files outside the package. The package should be self-contained, warn if not.

rules.name: usdUtilsValidators:RootPackageValidator
rules.summary: Files within the root layer of a usdz package should not be compressed or encrypted, and should be aligned to 64 bytes.

rules.name: usdUtilsValidators:UsdzPackageValidator
rules.summary: Files within all usdz packages within a stage should not be compressed or encrypted, and should be aligned to 64 bytes.

rules.name: usdValidation:AttributeTypeMismatch
rules.summary: Validator that checks for attribute type mismatch with the schema definition.

rules.name: usdValidation:CompositionErrorTest
rules.summary: Validator aims at providing all composition errors, which were generated while composing the stage.

rules.name: usdValidation:StageMetadataChecker
rules.summary: Stages that can be consumed as referenceable assets must have a valid 'defaultPrim' specified.

rules.name: ArticulationChecker
rules.summary: Implements validation of the following requirements: * JT.ART.002: Articulation roots cannot be nested. * JT.ART.004: Articulations are not allowed on static bodies.

rules.name: ColliderChecker
rules.summary: Implements validation of the following requirements: * RB.COL.004: The collision shape scale must be uniform for the following geometries: Sphere, Capsule, Cylinder, Cone & Points.

rules.name: DanglingOverPrimChecker
rules.summary: Prims usually need a ``def`` or ``class`` specifier, not just ``over`` specifiers. However, such overs may be used to hold relationship targets, attribute connections, or speculative opinions.

rules.name: DefaultPrimChecker
rules.summary: When working with layers that represent assets, it is often useful to have a single, active, Xformable or Scope type root prim as the layers default prim.

rules.name: ExtentsChecker
rules.summary: Boundable prims have the extent attribute. For point based prims, the value of the extent must be correct at each time sample of the point attribute

rules.name: IndexedPrimvarChecker
rules.summary: For Primvars with non-constant values of interpolation, it is often the case that the same value is repeated many times in the array. An indexed primvar can be used in such cases to optimize for data

rules.name: KindChecker
rules.summary: All kinds must be registered and conform to the rules specified in the `USD Glossary`_. .. _`USD Glossary`: https://graphics.pixar.com/usd/release/glossary.html?#usdglossary-kind

rules.name: LayerSpecChecker
rules.summary: This checker validates all LayerSpecs to ensure their type names and values types conform to SdfValueTypeNames. Also, their value types (including timesamples) should match the underlying type names.

rules.name: ManifoldChecker
rules.summary: Counts the number of non-manifold edges and vertices. A non-manifold edge has more than two adjacent faces. A non-manifold vertex as more than two adjacent border edges, where a border edge is an edge

rules.name: MassChecker
rules.summary: Implements validation of the following requirements: * RB.007: Rigid bodies _or_ their descendent collision shapes should have a mass & their other inertial properties explicitly specified.

rules.name: MaterialOutOfScopeChecker
rules.summary: USD ignores material bindings which target materials that are outside the payloads' hierarchy.

rules.name: MaterialPathChecker
rules.summary: MDL assets require absolute paths or relative paths prefixed with ``./`` to resolve properly. This Rule suggests to prefix ambiguous MDL asset path(s) with a ``./`` to enforce that it is a relative pa

rules.name: MaterialUsdPreviewSurfaceChecker
rules.summary: Rule ensuring that UsdShadeShader prims conform to the UsdPreviewSurface specification.

rules.name: MissingReferenceChecker
rules.summary: The composed USD stage should not contain any unresolvable asset dependencies (in every possible variation of the asset), when using the default asset resolver.

rules.name: NormalMapTextureChecker
rules.summary: UsdUVTexture nodes that feed the `inputs:normals` of a UsdPreviewSurface must ensure that the data is encoded and scaled properly. Specifically: - Since normals are expected to be in the range [(-1,-1

rules.name: NormalsExistChecker
rules.summary: Check that meshes have normals. All meshes should have normals unless they have the subdivision scheme set. Meshes cannot have both normals and subdivision set.

rules.name: NormalsValidChecker
rules.summary: Check that all normals have unit length, and that there are no non-finite values. Also checks that the supplied number of normal values agrees with the interpolation.

rules.name: NormalsWindingsChecker
rules.summary: Check that the mesh has normals that are consistent with the face windings, taking into account the 'orientation' attribute. We define the meaning of agreement between a normal attribute value and the

rules.name: PhysicsJointChecker
rules.summary: Implements validation of the following requirements: * JT.002: Targets set to Body0 and Body1 relationships must exist. * JT.003: Body0 and Body1 relationships must not have more than one target.

rules.name: PrimEncapsulationChecker
rules.summary: Check for basic prim encapsulation rules: - Boundables may not be nested under Gprims - Connectable prims (e.g. Shader, Material, etc) can only be nested inside other Container-like Connectable prims.

rules.name: RigidBodyChecker
rules.summary: Implements validation of the following requirements: * RB.005: Rigid bodies cannot be part of a scene graph instance. * RB.003: Rigid bodies have to be UsdGeomXformable prims. * RB.009: Rigid bodies h

rules.name: ShaderImplementationSourceChecker
rules.summary: Shader prims require a source implementation, which can be one of "id" (for builtins), "sourceAsset" (for assets), or "sourceCode" (for inline JIT compiled shaders). Source Asset or Source Code Shader

rules.name: SkelBindingAPIAppliedChecker
rules.summary: A prim providing skelBinding properties, must have SkelBindingAPI applied on the prim.

rules.name: StageMetadataChecker
rules.summary: All stages should declare their 'upAxis' and 'metersPerUnit'. Stages that can be consumed as referencable assets should furthermore have a valid 'defaultPrim' declared, and stages meant for consumer-l

rules.name: SubdivisionSchemeChecker
rules.summary: USD default value for subdivision scheme is Catmull-Clark. This is often overlooked and so set incorrectly for tessellated CAD geometry. This checker ensures that the subdivision scheme is explicitly

rules.name: TextureChecker
rules.summary: A RuleChecker which handles locating texture files automatically. Texture files should be readable by intended client (only .jpg or .png for consumer-level USDZ). Derived classes can reimplement `Text

rules.name: TypeChecker
rules.summary: All prims must have a type defined.

rules.name: UnicodeNameChecker
rules.summary: Checks prim, property, variant set, and variant names for ambiguities related to UTF encoding. UTF-8 encoded strings may have sequences of code points that describe equivalent text rendered to the use

rules.name: UnusedMeshTopologyChecker
rules.summary: Points which are not referenced by the indices can be removed. Works on non time varying geometry.

rules.name: UnusedPrimvarChecker
rules.summary: Values which are not referenced by the indices in a primvar can be removed. Works on non time varying geometry.

rules.name: UsdAsciiPerformanceChecker
rules.summary: For performance reasons, large arrays and time samples are better stored in crate files. This alerts users to any layers which contain large arrays or time sample dictionaries stored in .usda or ASCII

rules.name: UsdDanglingMaterialBinding
rules.summary: Rule ensuring that the bound material exists in the scene.

rules.name: UsdGeomSubsetChecker
rules.summary: Ensures that a valid family name attribute is set for every UsdGeomSubset that has a material binding.

rules.name: UsdLuxSchemaChecker
rules.summary: In USD 21.02, Lux attributes were prefixed with inputs: to make them connectable. This rule checker ensure that all UsdLux attributes have the appropriate prefix.

rules.name: UsdMaterialBindingApi
rules.summary: Rule ensuring that the MaterialBindingAPI is applied on all prims that have a material binding property.

rules.name: UsdzPackageValidator
rules.summary: This is Base class for all the rule-checkers. Args: verbose: Deprecated parameter, kept for backward compatibility. Not used in new rules. consumerLevelChecks: Deprecated parameter, kept for backward

rules.name: ValidateTopologyChecker
rules.summary: Validate the topology of a mesh on all time samples.

rules.name: WeldChecker
rules.summary: If attributes contain equal values they can be unified and the indices adjusted accordingly. Works on non time varying geometry.

rules.name: ZeroAreaFaceChecker
rules.summary: Faces with zero area can be removed. May produce welding after removal. Works on non time varying geometry.

rules.name: anchored-asset-paths
rules.summary: Asset references should use anchored paths

rules.name: supported-file-types
rules.summary: Asset must use only supported file types

rules.name: ade20k-labels
rules.summary: Every `SemanticsLabelsAPI:ade20k` label value must be a member of the ADE20K (150) taxonomy.

rules.name: forward-direction
rules.summary: An asset selecting Object Forward MUST declare its semantic facing on its defaultPrim.

rules.name: object-affordance-valid
rules.summary: If `SemanticsLabelsAPI:affordance` is applied to a prim, every authored value in `semantics:labels:affordance` must be one of the allowed affordance tokens.

rules.name: object-affordance-state-valid
rules.summary: If `SemanticsLabelsAPI:affordance_state` is applied to a prim, every authored value in `semantics:labels:affordance_state` must be one of the allowed state tokens.

rules.name: properties-sublayer-required
rules.summary: The USD stage must include a sublayer with "properties" in its filename (e.g., `AssetName_Properties.usda`) and that sublayer must specify a `defaultPrim`.

rules.name: asset-class-required
rules.summary: The default prim in the properties sublayer must have an `aif:core:assetClass` attribute identifying the equipment type.

rules.name: asset-identification-metadata
rules.summary: The default prim must have `aif:core:manufacturer`, `aif:core:modelNumber`, and `aif:core:assetVersion` attributes.

rules.name: physical-dimensions-metadata
rules.summary: The default prim must have all seven physical dimension attributes: `aif:core:height`, `aif:core:width`, `aif:core:depth`, `aif:core:weight`, `aif:core:overallGeometryDimensions`, `aif:core:installati

rules.name: simready-version-tracking
rules.summary: The default prim must have an `aif:core:simreadyVersion` attribute recording the SimReady specification version the asset was created against.

rules.name: asset-description-required
rules.summary: The default prim must have `aif:core:assetDescription` and `aif:core:connectsToModelDocumentation` attributes.

rules.name: equipment-class-template-compliance
rules.summary: The default prim must carry every `aif:spec:*` attribute that its declared equipment class defines.

rules.name: variation-discovery-metadata
rules.summary: Every advertised variation variant set MUST be declared under `customLayerData.SimReady_Metadata.Variants.<Category>.<VariantSetName>` with its owning prim, category, default option, and impact class.

rules.name: variant-set-location
rules.summary: A variation variant set MUST live on the asset's default (root) prim, declare at least two options, and author a valid default selection that names one of those options.

rules.name: option-composability
rules.summary: Every option of a variation variant set MUST compose to a valid stage, and the category's content requirements MUST hold under **each** option, not only under the authored default.

rules.name: section-purity-isolation
rules.summary: A per-part variation option MUST compose its content only through an isolated payload arc, and selecting one option MUST NOT change any content outside that part. A master option MUST author child var

rules.name: visual-envelope-invariant
rules.summary: Every option of a variation variant set MUST hold the asset's visual envelope size invariant within tolerance.

rules.name: collision-envelope-invariant
rules.summary: Every option of a variation variant set that carries colliders MUST hold the asset's collision envelope size invariant within tolerance.

rules.name: impact-class-honesty
rules.summary: A variant set's declared `impactClass` MUST match what its options actually change: a `visual-only` set changes no simulation-relevant data; a `simulation-affecting` set changes only the domain it dec

rules.name: conditional-presence
rules.summary: A variation variant set MUST exist if and only if its scope offers two or more options; a scope with a single representation carries no variant set.

rules.name: authored-physical-properties
rules.summary: An asset with a `Collision` variation MUST author its mass, center of mass, and inertia explicitly with `UsdPhysics.MassAPI`, and those values MUST be identical across every collider option.

rules.name: variation-stability
rules.summary: Across a variation set's options, no prim that is present in two or more options MAY change its prim **type** or its authored local **transform**. A variation MAY only add or remove geometry leaves un

rules.name: has-articulation-root
rules.summary: An articulated USD stage must contain exactly one prim with the UsdPhysicsArticulationRootAPI applied.

rules.name: non-adjacent-collision-meshes-do-not-clash
rules.summary: Collision meshes on non-adjacent links in the articulation hierarchy must not overlap or intersect.

rules.name: cityscapes-labels
rules.summary: Every `SemanticsLabelsAPI:cityscapes` label value must be a member of the Cityscapes (fine) taxonomy.

rules.name: connection-rels
rules.summary: The assembly default prim has a `Connections` Scope. Each connection prim under it authors exactly one `simready:mate:socket` relationship and exactly one `simready:mate:plug` relationship, each with

rules.name: connection-targets-resolve
rules.summary: Each `socket` and `plug` relationship target must resolve on the composed stage and satisfy `MC.001` and `MC.002`.

rules.name: opposite-roles
rules.summary: The two targets of a connection must have opposite roles: one `Socket` and one `Plug`.

rules.name: interface-match
rules.summary: The socket and plug `simready:mate:mechanical:interface` tokens must be equal by exact string comparison.

rules.name: payload-capacity
rules.summary: Socket `simready:mate:mechanical:maxPayload` must be greater than or equal to the plug subtree mass. Incomplete mass on rigid bodies in that subtree warns rather than fails. Only `jointed` connections

rules.name: mate-realization
rules.summary: Every connection prim must author `simready:mate:realization` as either `compound` or `jointed`, and the token must agree with how the two mate bodies resolve. `jointed` requires two distinct mate bod

rules.name: exclusive-pairing
rules.summary: No mate site may appear in more than one connection: a socket holds at most one plug, and a plug sits in at most one socket.

rules.name: assembly-type
rules.summary: The assembly default prim must author `simready:mate:assemblyType` with exactly one value drawn from the closed list `robot`, `pallet_stack`. A missing attribute or an unrecognized token fails.

rules.name: connection-joint
rules.summary: Every connection with `realization = "jointed"` must author `simready:mate:joint` targeting exactly one `UsdPhysicsFixedJoint` whose `physics:body0` and `physics:body1` resolve to the connection's two

rules.name: assembly-child-references
rules.summary: Each connected mate site must arrive on the assembly stage through a reference or payload arc to a separately published asset. Parts authored inline in the assembly's own root layer fail.

rules.name: compound-body
rules.summary: The mate body shared by a `compound` connection must be an assembly-local prim carrying no reference or payload arc, with an enabled `PhysicsRigidBodyAPI` and a `physics:mass` equal to the sum of the

rules.name: assembly-model-hierarchy
rules.summary: The assembly default prim must have `kind = "assembly"`. Each composed-in child asset root must have `kind = "component"` or `kind = "assembly"`, and every prim between the default prim and a child as

rules.name: coco-labels
rules.summary: Every `SemanticsLabelsAPI:coco` label value must be a member of the COCO (instances) taxonomy.

rules.name: collider-approximation-sdf
rules.summary: Every mesh collider (Mesh prim with USDPhysics.CollisionAPI and USDPhysics.MeshCollisionAPI) must have an SDF (Signed Distance Field) approximation for efficient collision detection.

rules.name: connectionpoints-scope-structure
rules.summary: Connection point prims must be organized under a `ConnectionPoints` Scope prim that is a direct child of the default prim.

rules.name: connection-point-geometry-type
rules.summary: Connection point prims must be Plane (rectangular) or Disk (circular) geometry only. The rule belongs to the v0.1.0 vocabulary: a v0.1.0 profile authors Plane and Disk geometry, a v0.2.0 profile autho

rules.name: connection-point-purpose-guide
rules.summary: All connection point prims must have their `purpose` attribute set to `"guide"`. The rule carries across both vocabularies: under v0.2.0 CP.010 applies it to connection point Xforms.

rules.name: connection-point-naming-convention
rules.summary: All prims under the `ConnectionPoints` scope must follow the `<vendor>_<type>_<suffix>` naming pattern using a valid type prefix from the AIF connection point type table.

rules.name: connection-points-composition
rules.summary: Connection points must be saved as a separate `<AssetName>_ConnectionPoints.usd` file and composed into the main stage as a sublayer.

rules.name: connection-point-alignment
rules.summary: Connection point geometry must be positioned and sized to match the actual physical openings on the equipment. The requirement is documented normatively and is listed by neither the v0.1.0 nor the v0.

rules.name: connection-point-prim-structure
rules.summary: Connection points must be Xform prims under the `ConnectionPoints` scope with `purpose = "guide"`, each carrying at least `simready:connectionPoint:domain` and `simready:connectionPoint:direction`.

rules.name: connection-point-base-namespace
rules.summary: Every connection point must carry all five base namespace properties, which together state the semantic identity of the connection.

rules.name: connection-point-domain-namespace
rules.summary: A connection point's domain-specific properties must sit in the namespace named by its `simready:connectionPoint:domain` value, and a production-complete connection point carries every property that n

rules.name: display-color-coverage
rules.summary: Every renderable geometry prim must resolve a display colour, authored on the prim or inherited from an ancestor.

rules.name: display-color-values
rules.summary: Authored display colour values must lie within the range a consumer can interpret.

rules.name: display-opacity-values
rules.summary: Display opacity, where authored, must lie within its valid range and agree with its declared interpolation.

rules.name: physics-drive-and-joint-state
rules.summary: Validate that each driven joint has correct drive configuration and joint state, including required limits and consistency checks against the current joint state values.

rules.name: joint-has-joint-state-api
rules.summary: Driven joints must implement proper joint state API for simulation state management.

rules.name: joint-has-correct-transform-and-state
rules.summary: Driven joints must maintain correct transform relationships and state consistency. ## Description

rules.name: physics-joint-has-drive-or-mimic-api
rules.summary: PhysX driven joints must implement drive API or mimic functionality for controlled motion.

rules.name: physics-joint-max-velocity
rules.summary: PhysX driven joints must have appropriate maximum velocity limits configured.

rules.name: drive-joint-value-reasonable
rules.summary: Drive joint parameters must be within reasonable ranges for stable simulation. The joint parameters should not be excessively big and should be natural numbers.

rules.name: mimic-api-check
rules.summary: Mimic API configuration must be properly validated for coordinated joint motion.

rules.name: robot-schema-joint-exist
rules.summary: Robot schema joints must exist and be properly defined for Isaac Sim integration.

rules.name: robot-schema-links-exist
rules.summary: Robot schema links must exist and be properly connected to joints for kinematic chain definition.

rules.name: check-robot-relationships
rules.summary: Robot joint and link relationships must be validated for proper kinematic tree structure.

rules.name: no-articulation-loops
rules.summary: The articulation must have no loops and at most one joint between any two bodies. Only joints that participate in the articulation are checked; joints with `physics:excludeFromArticulation = true` are

rules.name: nominal-voltage-required
rules.summary: AC-powered equipment must declare its nominal input voltage. The attribute name varies by equipment class.

rules.name: power-rating-required
rules.summary: AC-powered equipment must declare its power rating. The attribute name varies by equipment class.

rules.name: electrical-frequency-required
rules.summary: AC-powered equipment must declare its input frequency. The attribute name varies by equipment class.

rules.name: electrical-connection-points
rules.summary: AC-powered equipment must have at least one electrical connection point, identified by its name in AIF 0.1.0 or its domain property in AIF 0.2.0.

rules.name: gripper-socket-type
rules.summary: Every gripper site prim must be an `Xform` with `token simready:attactment:socketType = "Gripper"` authored, positioned at the grasp center between the finger pads.

rules.name: gripper-forward-axis
rules.summary: Every gripper site prim must contain a child `BasisCurves` prim named `gripper_forward_axis` with at least 2 points defining the gripper approach direction.

rules.name: gripper-grip-line
rules.summary: Every gripper site prim must contain a child `BasisCurves` prim named `gripper_grip_line` with at least 2 points defining the axis of the imaginary tube the gripper can grasp.

rules.name: gripper-max-opening
rules.summary: Every gripper site prim must declare a `gripper_maxOpening` float attribute with a positive value (in meters) recording the maximum jaw separation.

rules.name: graspable-vector-line
rules.summary: In order for an asset to be considered graspable, an asset must have at least 1 line object defined within the asset. A line is at least 2 points in space, and this line must intersect the asset that

rules.name: hierarchy-has-root
rules.summary: All prims in the hierarchy must be direct or indirect descendents of a single root root prim, preventing scattered or disconnected Xform hierarchies.

rules.name: exclusive-xform-parent-for-usdgeom
rules.summary: Every UsdGeomGprim must have a parent Xform with specific transform operations and hierarchy constraints.

rules.name: root-is-xformable
rules.summary: The root prim of a hierarchy must be transformable, meaning its' prim type must inherit from UsdGeomXformable and be capable of receiving transform operations.

rules.name: stage-has-default-prim
rules.summary: Stage must specify a default prim to define the root entry point.

rules.name: xform-common-api-usage
rules.summary: Transformations (translate, rotate, scale, pivot) on prims that are intended to be translated, rotated or scaled by users (e.g. the root prim of an asset) should conform to the UsdGeomXformCommonAPI.

rules.name: placeable-posable-are-xformable
rules.summary: All prims representing distinct objects or groups that require placement, posing or animation shall inherit from UsdGeomXformable.

rules.name: dummy-requirement
rules.summary: This is a placeholder requirement to maintain sequential numbering in the hierarchy requirements.

rules.name: logical-geometry-grouping
rules.summary: Geometry should be grouped under parent Xforms in a way that is logical for the object's structure and intended use in layouts or simulations.

rules.name: kinematic-chain-hierarchy
rules.summary: For assets (e.g., a robot with multiple articulated joints), the hierarchy should reflect the kinematic chain, with appropriate Xforms for each transformable link.

rules.name: undefined-prims
rules.summary: Assets must not contain undefined prims (overs)

rules.name: composition
rules.summary: The asset must be composed correctly for Isaac Sim using one of the supported layer layouts and a reference or payload arc to its base layer.

rules.name: joint-capability
rules.summary: Rigid bodies which are not free floating should be connected using joints.

rules.name: joint-body-target-exists
rules.summary: Targets set to Body0 and Body1 relationships must exist.

rules.name: joint-no-multiple-body-targets
rules.summary: Body0 and Body1 relationships must not have more than one target.

rules.name: lidar-omni-lidar-schema
rules.summary: LiDAR sensors must be represented as OmniLidar prims with OmniSensorGenericLidarCoreAPI applied. The legacy UsdGeom.Camera with cameraSensorType="lidar" pattern is not allowed.

rules.name: lidar-emitter-state-length
rules.summary: Every emitter state array attribute on an OmniLidar prim must have the same length as `omni:sensor:Core:numberOfEmitters`, and all emitter state arrays must be mutually consistent in length.

rules.name: lidar-scan-rate-minimum
rules.summary: The `omni:sensor:Core:scanRateBaseHz` attribute on an OmniLidar prim must be at least 0.466 Hz.

rules.name: lidar-solid-state-rays-per-line
rules.summary: For solid-state OmniLidar prims, the sum of all elements in `omni:sensor:Core:numRaysPerLine` must equal `omni:sensor:Core:numberOfEmitters`.

rules.name: mate-site-xform
rules.summary: A mate site is an `Xform` with authored `simready:mate:domain` and `simready:mate:role`. Those attributes are the discovery mechanism; prim names are unconstrained.

rules.name: mechanical-role
rules.summary: A mechanical mate site must author `simready:mate:domain = "mechanical"` and `simready:mate:role` of `Socket` or `Plug`. `Peer` is not part of this feature.

rules.name: mate-body-rigid-ancestor
rules.summary: Every mechanical mate site must have an ancestor with an enabled `PhysicsRigidBodyAPI`. That ancestor is the site's **mate body** — the rigid body a jointed connection attaches to, and the actor a com

rules.name: mechanical-interface
rules.summary: Every mechanical mate site must author a non-empty `simready:mate:mechanical:interface` token.

rules.name: mate-insertion-vector
rules.summary: If a mate site has a child `mate_insertion_vector`, it must be a `BasisCurves` prim with `type = "linear"`, `curveVertexCounts = [2]`, and a non-zero direction `p1 - p0`.

rules.name: socket-max-payload
rules.summary: A mechanical Socket mate site must author `simready:mate:mechanical:maxPayload` as a positive float. The value is always kilograms, regardless of stage units.

rules.name: mechanical-kind
rules.summary: If `simready:mate:mechanical:kind` is authored, its value should be one of `Tool`, `Gripper`, `Sensor`, `ToolChanger`, `ManipulatorFlange`. Unrecognized tokens warn; they do not fail.

rules.name: prim-naming-convention
rules.summary: Prims shall follow consistent naming conventions

rules.name: file-naming-convention
rules.summary: USD files shall follow consistent naming conventions

rules.name: directory-structure
rules.summary: Asset directories shall use consistent naming and logical organization

rules.name: path-length-limits
rules.summary: File and directory paths shall not exceed platform limits

rules.name: asset-folder-structure
rules.summary: The folder holding the main asset file must not contain any other USD file.

rules.name: metadata-location
rules.summary: Asset metadata must be stored in the USD file or a sidecar JSON file

rules.name: relative-paths
rules.summary: All references must use relative paths

rules.name: assetpath-validation
rules.summary: All asset, reference, and payload paths must resolve to files that exist

rules.name: material-attributes
rules.summary: Materials must specify additional "non-visual" material attributes

rules.name: material-base
rules.summary: Materials must specify a base material type

rules.name: material-coating
rules.summary: Materials must specify surface coating

rules.name: material-binding
rules.summary: Attributes must be on bound materials

rules.name: material-consistency
rules.summary: Properties must be consistent with visual materials

rules.name: material-time
rules.summary: Properties must not be time-varying

rules.name: fixed-joint-no-mergeable-body-pair
rules.summary: The asset must contain no two dynamic rigid bodies joined by an unbreakable fixed joint, unless one of them carries `PhysxContactReportAPI`, or contains an `IsaacContactSensor`, `IsaacImuSensor`, `Isa

rules.name: rigid-body-no-multiple-visual-meshes
rules.summary: No rigid body may own two or more mergeable visual meshes.

rules.name: render-only-no-inactive-collision-schemas
rules.summary: Renderable prims with no active collision shape must not retain collision API schemas.

rules.name: material-no-materialx-render-context
rules.summary: Materials must have no connected MaterialX render-context outputs.

rules.name: collider-material-binding
rules.summary: Every collider (prim with PhysicsCollisionAPI) must have a material:binding:physics relationship to a physics material.

rules.name: imu-sensor-rigid-body
rules.summary: An `IsaacImuSensor` prim must be a descendant of a prim that has `PhysicsRigidBodyAPI` applied.

rules.name: joint-sensor-articulation-root
rules.summary: An `IsaacJointStateSensor` prim must also have `PhysicsArticulationRootAPI` applied.

rules.name: rigid-body-capability
rules.summary: Assets must contain at least one rigid body

rules.name: rigid-body-schema-application
rules.summary: Rigid bodies have to be UsdGeomXformable prims.

rules.name: rigid-body-no-instancing
rules.summary: Rigid bodies cannot be part of a scene graph instance.

rules.name: rigid-body-no-nesting
rules.summary: Rigid bodies can not be nested unless xformOp reset xform stack is used.

rules.name: rigid-body-mass
rules.summary: Rigid bodies _or_ their descendant collision shapes must have a mass specification.

rules.name: rigid-body-detailed-mass
rules.summary: Rigid bodies _or_ their descendent collision shapes may have detailed mass properties including density, center of mass, and inertia tensor. When authored, these detailed mass properties must be inter

rules.name: rigid-body-schema-no-skew-matrix
rules.summary: Rigid bodies have to be UsdGeomXformable prims without skew matrix.

rules.name: invisible-collision-mesh-has-purpose-guide
rules.summary: Invisible collision meshes must have their purpose attribute set to 'guide' to be properly excluded from rendering.

rules.name: nested-rigid-body-mass
rules.summary: Every rigid body must have a valid (positive) `physics:mass` on itself or on at least one of its child colliders. Nested rigid body subtrees are excluded from the traversal. Negative mass is always a

rules.name: rigid-body-no-nesting-without-joint
rules.summary: Rigid bodies should not be nested unless they are connected by a joint.

rules.name: rigid-body-collider
rules.summary: Enabled rigid bodies must have collision geometry.

rules.name: clean-folder
rules.summary: Robot asset folders contain only referenced, required files. No stray or unused content. At the main level of a robot asset, only the interface layer is present. All other required content is bundled

rules.name: no-overrides
rules.summary: Robot USDs avoid local override layers that mask upstream schemas or physics.

rules.name: robot-naming
rules.summary: Canonical robot and prim naming conventions for stable references and tools.

rules.name: thumbnail-exist
rules.summary: The robot interface asset file should contain a thumbnail. The thumbnail should be representative of the robot.

rules.name: verify-robot-physics-attribute-source-layer
rules.summary: Validates that physics attributes are authored in the physics layer.

rules.name: verify-robot-physics-schema-source-layer
rules.summary: Validates that physics schema are authored in the physics layer.

rules.name: robot-schema
rules.summary: Robot USDs declare and use the required schemas and physics attributes.

rules.name: robot-type
rules.summary: Robot assets must declare a valid robot type on the default prim. The `isaac:robotType` attribute must be present, must be one of the schema-defined allowed tokens, and must not be `"Default"`. Allowe

rules.name: root-joint-pinned
rules.summary: The root joint (the first target of `isaac:physics:robotJoints`) must be pinned for robot types that require a fixed base (e.g. Manipulator, End Effector) and must not be pinned for other robot types.

rules.name: no-nested-materials
rules.summary: Materials must not contain nested materials to avoid unexpected rendering behavior.

rules.name: materials-on-top-level-only
rules.summary: Materials must only be defined in the top-level Looks prim following USD best practices for material organization.

rules.name: ros2-bridge-nodes-present
rules.summary: The stage must contain at least one OmniGraph node whose `node:type` starts with `isaacsim.ros2.bridge.`.

rules.name: render-product-camera
rules.summary: A RenderProduct prim must have a `camera` relationship targeting a valid prim.

rules.name: render-product-ordered-vars
rules.summary: A RenderProduct prim must have an `orderedVars` relationship containing at least one valid UsdRender.Var prim.

rules.name: render-var-source-name
rules.summary: A `RenderVar` prim must have a non-empty `sourceName` attribute.

rules.name: semantic-aov-compression
rules.summary: RenderVar prims whose `sourceName` starts with "semantic" must use BLOSC compression.

rules.name: compression-type-valid
rules.summary: The `srtx:compression:type` attribute on a `RenderVar` prim, if present, must be one of the four supported codec values: `hevc`, `h264`, `av1`, or `blosc`.

rules.name: generic-model-output-compression
rules.summary: `RenderVar` prims with `sourceName = "GenericModelOutput"` should use BLOSC compression (`srtx:compression:type = "blosc"`).

rules.name: physx-variant-set
rules.summary: The asset's default prim must expose a `PhysX` physics runtime variant set with `Disabled` and `Enabled` options, defaulting to `Disabled`.

rules.name: physx-runtime-payload
rules.summary: The `PhysX` variant set's `Enabled` option must compose its runtime layer with an anchored `prepend payload` that resolves to `./runnables/physics/physx.usd(a)`.

rules.name: physx-variant-metadata
rules.summary: The `PhysX` variant set must be documented in `customLayerData.SimReady_Metadata.Variants.Physics.PhysX`, declaring its `prim`, `variantSetName`, and `activateOption`.

rules.name: newton-variant-set
rules.summary: The asset's default prim must expose a `Newton` physics runtime variant set with `Disabled` and `Enabled` options, defaulting to `Disabled`.

rules.name: newton-runtime-payload
rules.summary: The `Newton` variant set's `Enabled` option must compose its runtime layer with an anchored `prepend payload` that resolves to `./runnables/physics/newton.usd(a)`.

rules.name: newton-variant-metadata
rules.summary: The `Newton` variant set must be documented in `customLayerData.SimReady_Metadata.Variants.Physics.Newton`, declaring its `prim`, `variantSetName`, and `activateOption`.

rules.name: mujoco-variant-set
rules.summary: The asset's default prim must expose a `MuJoCo` physics runtime variant set with `Disabled` and `Enabled` options, defaulting to `Disabled`.

rules.name: mujoco-runtime-payload
rules.summary: The `MuJoCo` variant set's `Enabled` option must compose its runtime layer with an anchored `prepend payload` that resolves to `./runnables/physics/mujoco.usd(a)`.

rules.name: mujoco-variant-metadata
rules.summary: The `MuJoCo` variant set must be documented in `customLayerData.SimReady_Metadata.Variants.Physics.MuJoCo`, declaring its `prim`, `variantSetName`, and `activateOption`.

rules.name: runtime-variant-section-purity

rules.name: runtime-physics-isolation
rules.summary: When a single physics runtime variant is selected, the composed stage must contain only that runtime's physics schemas and attributes plus the runtime-neutral base. Foreign-runtime schemas and conflic

rules.name: semantic-label-capability
rules.summary: All renderable geometry must be semantically labeled.

rules.name: semantic-label-deprecated-schema
rules.summary: Deprecated SemanticsAPI labels must be migrated to the SemanticsLabelsAPI schema.

rules.name: semantic-label-schema
rules.summary: Semantic labels must use the SemanticsLabelsAPI schema

rules.name: splat-prim-type
rules.summary: The asset's visual representation must be a `ParticleField3DGaussianSplat` prim.

rules.name: splat-has-positions
rules.summary: Each `ParticleField3DGaussianSplat` prim must author `positions`.

rules.name: splat-has-scales
rules.summary: Each `ParticleField3DGaussianSplat` prim must author `scales`, one per Gaussian.

rules.name: splat-has-orientations
rules.summary: Each `ParticleField3DGaussianSplat` prim must author `orientations`, one per Gaussian.

rules.name: splat-has-opacities
rules.summary: Each `ParticleField3DGaussianSplat` prim must author `opacities`, one per Gaussian.

rules.name: splat-has-radiance

rules.name: metadata-whitelist
rules.summary: The asset stage must contain all required metadata fields in root-layer `customLayerData`.

rules.name: thumbnail-exist
rules.summary: The SimReady asset file should contain a thumbnail that is representative of the asset.

rules.name: nested-simready-metadata
rules.summary: Required SimReady provenance fields must be authored inside the root-layer `SimReady_Metadata` dictionary.

rules.name: metadata-union
rules.summary: Required SimReady provenance fields must be present in the union of USD custom layer data and an optional sidecar JSON file.

rules.name: sunrgbd-labels
rules.summary: Every `SemanticsLabelsAPI:sunrgbd` label value must be a member of the SUN RGB-D (10) taxonomy.

rules.name: nominal-cooling-capacity
rules.summary: CDUs and CRAHs must declare `aif:spec:nominalCoolingCapacity`: the rated cooling capacity of the unit.

rules.name: thermal-cooling-connection-points
rules.summary: Cooling equipment must have connection point prims matching its piping interface types: CDUs require FWS and TCS connection points; CRAHs require liquid supply and return connection points.

rules.name: default-prim
rules.summary: The stage must declare a valid `defaultPrim` so consumers can resolve the asset root.

rules.name: upaxis
rules.summary: Stage must specify upAxis to define the orientation of the stage

rules.name: meters-per-unit
rules.summary: Stage must specify metersPerUnit to define the linear unit scale

rules.name: kilograms-per-unit
rules.summary: Stage must specify kilogramsPerUnit to define the mass unit scale, if physics objects are present in the stage.

rules.name: corrective-transforms
rules.summary: Must apply corrective transforms for different units

rules.name: timecodes-per-second
rules.summary: Stage must specify timeCodesPerSecond, if timesamples are present in the stage.

rules.name: upaxis-z
rules.summary: Stage must specify upAxis = "Z" to define the orientation of the stage

rules.name: meters-per-unit-1

rules.name: at-least-one-imageable-geometry
rules.summary: Assets must contain at least one Imageable Geometry

rules.name: usdgeom-extent
rules.summary: Boundable geometry primitives must have valid extent values.

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-internal-geometry
rules.summary: Only include geometry that contributes to visualization or simulation

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-empty-spaces
rules.summary: Use efficient mesh boundaries for performance

rules.name: usdgeom-boundable-size
rules.summary: Meshes should maintain appropriate scale and boundary volumes

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-overlap
rules.summary: Meshes should not overlap unnecessarily

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-manifold
rules.summary: Mesh geometry must be manifold

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-coincident
rules.summary: Meshes should not share the exact same space

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-primvar-indexing
rules.summary: Use indexed primvars when values are repeated

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-subdivision
rules.summary: Use subdivision only when needed for smooth surfaces or displacement

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-primvar-usage
rules.summary: Only include primvars that are actively used

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-small
rules.summary: Combine small meshes into larger ones where appropriate

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-tessellation-density
rules.summary: Use appropriate tessellation density for geometry

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-topology
rules.summary: Mesh topology must be valid

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-identical-timesamples
rules.summary: Use time samples only when attribute values change

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-colocated-points
rules.summary: Each vertex position should be unique

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-primitive-tessellation
rules.summary: Avoid tessellating primitive shapes

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-unused-topology
rules.summary: Mesh topology should be without unused vertices, edges, or faces.

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-zero-area
rules.summary: Faces should have non-zero area.

rules.name: usdgeom-pointbased-points-precision
rules.summary: The values of `points` must not exceed the limit at which a given precision can be represented using 32-bit floats.

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-transparent-is-watertight
rules.summary: Transparent physical bodies should be watertight to allow for simulation of light transmission and refraction.

rules.name: mesh-xform-positioning
rules.summary: Meshes should be positioned with xform ops rather than by "baking" transformations into point positions.

rules.name: identical-mesh-consistency
rules.summary: Repeated occurrences of identically shaped objects should have identical mesh connectivity

rules.name: asset-origin-positioning
rules.summary: Geometry shall be defined as such that the asset is correctly positioned and oriented at the origin (0,0,0).

rules.name: asset-pivot-placement
rules.summary: The pivot point of an asset should be positioned logically: at the center of the object's base for ground plane objects, and at the center of rotation for objects that rotate around specific points.

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-normals-exist
rules.summary: All non-subdivided meshes must have normals.

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-normals-must-be-valid
rules.summary: Mesh normals values must be valid to produce correct shading.

rules.name: usdgeom-mesh-winding-order
rules.summary: The winding order of faces in a mesh must correctly represent the orientation (front/back) of the face.

rules.name: pascal-voc-labels
rules.summary: Every `SemanticsLabelsAPI:pascal_voc` label value must be a member of the PASCAL VOC (20) taxonomy.

rules.name: ov-usdz-udim-limitation

rules.name: newton-articulation-root-config
rules.summary: Newton articulation roots must use standard `UsdPhysics.ArticulationRootAPI` and author explicit Newton self-collision configuration.

rules.name: conformance-metadata
rules.summary: Packages MAY include conformance metadata files recording SimReady Foundations validation results, following defined naming and JSON schema conventions

rules.name: root-usds
rules.summary: Packages MAY include an OpenUSD root layers metadata file declaring the top-level USD entry points that should be validated as self-contained assets

rules.name: mujoco-connection-joint

rules.name: newton-connection-joint

rules.name: physx-connection-joint
rules.summary: A `jointed` connection joint must remain a standard `UsdPhysicsFixedJoint` with explicit `physics:collisionEnabled = false`, must not apply `PhysxJointAPI` degree-of-freedom tuning, and must leave `ph

rules.name: imagenet-labels
rules.summary: Every `SemanticsLabelsAPI:imagenet_1k` label value must be a member of the ImageNet-1K taxonomy.

rules.name: geom-shall-be-mesh
rules.summary: All geometry shall be represented as non-subdivided mesh primitives using the UsdGeomMesh schema.

rules.name: usdgeom-boundable-size-rtx-limit
rules.summary: World space bounds must not exceed RTX limit.

rules.name: material-assignment
rules.summary: Each renderable GPrim must have a computed material bound to it

rules.name: material-bind-scope
rules.summary: A material binding inside a payload must target a material inside that payload.

rules.name: material-final-surface
rules.summary: A renderable GPrim's material must provide a physically based final surface.

rules.name: material-mdl-schema
rules.summary: An MDL shader must use the current schema attributes, not the deprecated `mdlMaterial` form.

rules.name: material-mdl-source-asset
rules.summary: An MDL shader's `info:mdl:sourceAsset` must name an existing `.mdl` file by an anchored path.

rules.name: material-mdl-surface-present
rules.summary: A renderable GPrim's material must connect an MDL surface on `outputs:mdl:surface`.

rules.name: material-pbr-parameter-ranges
rules.summary: OpenPBR input attributes must hold values within their defined min/max.

rules.name: material-preview-surface
rules.summary: UsdPreviewSurface inputs must use the types and token values the specification declares.

rules.name: material-preview-surface-present
rules.summary: A renderable GPrim's material must connect a UsdPreviewSurface on `outputs:surface`.

rules.name: material-shader-inputs
rules.summary: Shader inputs must use the type their specification declares and hold a finite value.

rules.name: material-shading-network-structure
rules.summary: Shader ids must name a declared node, connections must have an existing target, and the material must connect a surface terminal.

rules.name: material-texture-colorspace-mdl
rules.summary: A texture's `colorSpace` must match how its MDL input reads the image.

rules.name: material-texture-colorspace-mdl-deprecated
rules.summary: Deprecated. See VM.TEX.005 for the current requirement.

rules.name: material-texture-colorspace-openpbr
rules.summary: A texture's `colorSpace` must match how its OpenPBR input reads the image.

rules.name: material-texture-colorspace-preview
rules.summary: A texture's `inputs:sourceColorSpace` must match how its UsdPreviewSurface input reads the image.

rules.name: material-texture-maxsize
rules.summary: Texture dimensions must not exceed 16,384 pixels on either axis.

rules.name: hash-object-format
rules.summary: Hash fields MUST be objects containing at least a `sha256` key with lowercase hexadecimal value. Implementations SHOULD also include `blake3` and/or `blake2b` when available, for performance. When `co

rules.name: metadata-files
rules.summary: Metadata files MUST be JSON with UTF-8 encoding, use reverse domain naming, and follow write-once semantics

rules.name: package-definition
rules.summary: Each package MUST have exactly one valid package definition with a globally unique, case-insensitive, immutable identity, placed at the package root alongside a `.metadata/` folder

rules.summary: The BOM is a metadata file identified by the name `com.nvidia.simready.packaging.bom.json`. It MUST list all content files in the package with per-item fields, using forward-slash relative paths with

rules.name: mujoco-actuator-targets
rules.summary: MuJoCo actuator prims must target valid MuJoCo-driven USD physics joints and author valid actuator parameter values.

rules.name: mujoco-joint-api
rules.summary: MuJoCo driven joints must use standard `UsdPhysics.Joint` prims with `MjcJointAPI` applied to every non-fixed articulation joint.

rules.name: newton-joint-attributes
rules.summary: Authored Newton joint tuning must use `NewtonJointAPI` (or the equivalent `newton:*` attributes) on `UsdPhysics.Joint` prims with valid values.

rules.name: newton-joint-drive-api

rules.name: newton-mimic-api
rules.summary: When `NewtonMimicAPI` is applied, it must be on a `UsdPhysics.Joint`, target a valid leader joint, and author valid mimic coefficients.

rules.name: gripper-site-api
rules.summary: Every gripper site prim must have `IsaacSiteAPI` applied and `isaac:Description` authored so Isaac Sim tooling can discover and configure it automatically.

rules.name: mujoco-gripper-site-api
rules.summary: MuJoCo gripper site prims must apply `MjcSiteAPI`.

rules.name: articulation
rules.summary: For stable and fast simulations of kinematic chains, an asset should define an articulation.

rules.name: articulation-no-nesting
rules.summary: Articulation roots cannot be nested.

rules.name: articulation-not-on-kinematic-body
rules.summary: Articulations are not allowed on kinematic bodies.

rules.name: articulation-not-on-static-body
rules.summary: Articulations are not allowed on static bodies.

rules.name: newton-material-attributes
rules.summary: `NewtonMaterialAPI` must be applied on a physics `Material` — a `UsdShade.Material` that also carries `PhysicsMaterialAPI`.

rules.name: collider-capability
rules.summary: Colliding Gprims must apply the Collision API.

rules.name: collider-mesh
rules.summary: The Mesh Collision API can only be assigned to Mesh Prims.

rules.name: collider-non-uniform-scale
rules.summary: The collision shape scale must be uniform for the following geometries: Sphere, Capsule, Cylinder, Cone & Points.

rules.name: mujoco-collider-api
rules.summary: MuJoCo collision shapes must apply `MjcCollisionAPI` on valid USD collision geometry.

rules.name: mujoco-mesh-collision-api

rules.name: newton-collider-api
rules.summary: Newton colliders must use a valid Newton collision schema.

rules.name: newton-mass-attributes

rules.name: newton-sdf-attributes

rules.name: semantic-label-material

rules.name: semantic-label-qcode-valid
